title: MaaCore resource/config.json
description: Connection and runtime options for MaaCore. Some controller behavior is selected by the connection `configName` instead of by fields in this file; see the `configName` description.

version.description: Format version of this file. Currently `1.0`.

packageName.description: Package name of the game client for each package type.

connection.description: Available connection configurations. Each entry describes either a complete controller setup or, when `baseConfig` is set, an override of another entry.

options.description: Runtime options shared by all controllers.

_Doc$.description: Human-readable note for the sibling option.

taskDelay.description: Image recognition delay (ms). Lower means more responsive but more CPU intensive. Default `500`.

SSSFightScreencapInterval.description: Minimal interval (ms) between two SSS fight screencaps. Default `16` (~60fps).

RoguelikeFightScreencapInterval.description: Minimal interval (ms) between two Roguelike fight screencaps. Default `100`.

CopilotFightScreencapInterval.description: Minimal interval (ms) between two screencaps for all other copilot fights. Default `16` (~60fps).

battleStartTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time (s) to wait for a battle to start. Default `60`.

controlDelayRange.description: Random delay (ms) added before each control action, to evade detection. Format `[minimum, maximum]`. Default `[0, 0]` (no delay).

adbExtraSwipeDist.description: Extra swipe distance (px) used to work around an ADB bug where swipes occasionally overshoot. Default `100`.

adbExtraSwipeDuration.description: Duration (ms) of the extra ADB swipe. A negative value disables the extra swipe. Default `500`.

adbSwipeDurationMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to ADB swipe duration. Default `10.0`.

adbSwipeXDistanceMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to ADB swipe horizontal distance. Default `0.8`.

minitouchSwipeExtraEndDelay.description: Extra delay (ms) added to the end of a Minitouch swipe. Default `150`.

minitouchExtraSwipeDuration.description: Duration (ms) of the extra Minitouch swipe. Default `200`.

minitouchProgramsOrder.description: Search order for the Minitouch program. Default `["x86_64", "x86", "arm64-v8a", "armeabi-v7a", "armeabi"]`.

swipeWithPauseRequiredDistance.description: Minimum distance (px) of a deployment swipe required to trigger a pause. Default `20`.

dropUrl.description: Stage drop data upload endpoint. Default `"https://backend.yituliu.cn/maa/upload/stageDrop"`.

cleanFilesFreq.description: Run `save_debug_image` cleanup every N saves. Default `5`.

maxDebugFileNum.description: Maximum number of debug images to keep. Default `10`.

configName.description:
Name of this connection configuration. Most controllers read the fields below, but a few also special-case specific names:

- `DEBUG`: pseudo configuration available only in `ASST_DEBUG` builds.
- `AVD`: handled in MaaFwAdbController; decides whether ADB extras are passed to `MaaAdbControlUnitCreate`.
- `MuMuEmulator12`: handled in `AdbController::init_mumu_extras`.
- `LDPlayer`: handled in `AdbController::init_ld_extras`.
- `MacBGR`: not a config.json entry. `PlayToolsController::connect` asks PlayCover for BGR screenshots, which are smaller.
- `MacSCK`: not a config.json entry. `PlayToolsController::connect` captures with the system ScreenCaptureKit instead of through PlayCover.
- Any other name used with PlayTools keeps the default PlayCover RGBA screenshot.

baseConfig.description: Inherit all fields from the connection entry with this `configName`, then override them with the fields below.

devices.description: Command that lists available devices. Parsed with `addressRegex`.

connect.description: Command that connects to the device.

uuid.description: Command that returns a stable device identifier.

version.description: Command that returns the Android version.

display.description: Command that returns the screen resolution. Parsed with `displayFormat`.

ncAddress.description: Command that returns the address used for the netcat-based screenshot methods.

abilist.description: Command that returns the supported ABIs.

orientation.description: Command that returns the current screen orientation.

pushMinitouch.description: Command that pushes the Minitouch/MaaTouch binary to the device.

chmodMinitouch.description: Command that makes the pushed binary executable.

screencapEncode.description: Screenshot command using `screencap -p` (PNG encoding on device).

back_to_home.description: Command that returns to the home screen.

release.description: Command that releases all touch points.

displayId.description: Command that returns the display id used for `screencap -d`.

fps.description: Command that returns the current frame rate.

eventId.description: Command that returns the input event id used for touch injection.

addressRegex.description: Regular expression that extracts the device address from the output of `devices`.

displayFormat.description: Format string that combines the numbers returned by `display`, e.g. `%d%d`.
